title: I have some things to say - Core i9 & X299
summary: Linus Tech Tips' rant on Intel's X299 platform and Core i9 launch, criticizing how Intel segments the market by limiting PCIe lanes and charging for features like VROC keys.
why: HN cites it as a source for Intel's market-segmentation tactics on its high-end desktop platform.

quote.text: Linus Tech Tips has a rant about how Intel is trying to segment the market by only offering more PCI-E lanes on the most-expensive CPUs
